mapper.select:
select distinct t1.id, t1.role_type_name, t1.parent_id, !ISNULL(t2.id) flag, t1.create_time from bp_role_type t1 left JOIN bp_role t2 ON t1.id = t2.role_type_id AND t2.is_deleted = 0 where t1.is_deleted = 0
and t1.role_type_name like concat('%',#{name},'%')

SELECT t1.id,t1.role_name,t1.role_type_id,t1.description,t1.role_type_id,t2.role_type_name FROM bp_role t1 left join bp_role_type t2 on t1.role_type_id = t2.id -- 过滤管理员账号 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0 and t1.id != 1
and t1.role_type_id in
#{item}
and t1.role_name like concat('%',#{roleName},'%')
order by t1.create_time desc

select distinct t1.id,t1.role_type_name,t1.role_type_name name,t1.parent_id from bp_role_type t1 join bp_role t2 on t1.id=t2.role_type_id left join bp_role_menu t3 on t2.id=t3.role_id where t1.is_deleted = 0 and t2.is_deleted=0
and t3.menu_id = #{menuId}
SELECT t1.id,t1.role_type_id,t1.role_name,t1.role_name name FROM bp_role t1 JOIN bp_role_type t2 ON t1.role_type_id = t2.id AND t2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0

select t2.user_id,t2.user_name,t2.login_name from bp_user_role t1 left join bp_user t2 on t1.user_id=t2.user_id and t2.is_deleted=0 where t1.is_deleted = 0
and t1.role_id = #{roleId}
select t1.id, t1.role_name, t1.role_type_id, t1.create_time from bp_role t1 join bp_user_role t2 on t1.id = t2.role_id and t2.is_deleted = false where t2.user_id = #{userId} and id != 1

select r.id, r.role_name, r.role_name as name, r.role_name as role_name, r.role_type_id as parent_id, r.create_time from bp_role r join bp_role_menu m on r.id = m.role_id and r.is_deleted = 0 where m.menu_id = #{menuId}
select id, role_type_name as name, role_type_name as roleTypeName, parent_id, create_time from bp_role_type where is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, role_name, is_deleted FROM bp_role WHERE id IN
#{id}
